parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.name as project_name, p.project_type, p.budget_target, p.budget_flexible, p.location_address, p.location_city, p.location_province, p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.urgency, c.name as client_name, c.email as client_email, pii_decrypt(c.phone_enc) as client_phone, (SELECT json_build_object('id', b.id, 'version', b.version, 'summary', b.summary, 'objectives', b.objectives, 'client_needs', pii_decrypt(b.client_needs_enc)::jsonb, 'constraints', b.constraints, 'style_preferences', b.style_preferences, 'rooms_affected', b.rooms_affected, 'status', b.status) FROM briefings b WHERE b.project_id = p.id AND b.status = 'approved' ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) as briefing, (SELECT row_to_json(d.*) FROM design_options d WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND d.is_selected = true LIMIT 1) as design_option, (SELECT row_to_json(ce.*) FROM cost_estimates ce WHERE ce.project_id = p.id ORDER BY ce.version DESC LIMIT 1) as cost_estimate, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('trade_type', tr.trade_type, 'scope_description', tr.scope_description) ORDER BY tr.trade_type) FROM trade_requests tr WHERE tr.project_id = p.id AND tr.status = 'prepared') as trade_assignments FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO proposals (project_id, version, title, executive_summary, scope_description, total_price, payment_conditions, estimated_duration, inclusions, exclusions, status, webhook_token) VALUES ($1::uuid, 1, $2, $3, $4, $5::numeric, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9::jsonb, 'pending_review', gen_random_uuid()::text) RETURNING id, webhook_token
